summary.zh: 设定弹窗的触发时机、频率、优惠与文案，避免伤体验
summary.en: Set popup triggers, frequency, offer and copy without hurting the page

description.zh: 为弹窗、模态框、退出意图提示、侧滑条和横幅定规则：什么时候出现、出现多频繁、给什么优惠、文案怎么写，同时控制对页面体验的干扰。适合新建弹窗，或弹窗关掉率高、连带拉低转化时使用。
description.en: Sets the rules for popups, modals, exit-intent prompts, slide-ins and banners: when they fire, how often, what offer to make and how to word it, without hurting the page. Use it to build a new popup or fix one people close on sight.
